exercises.name: AC Boulder Mileage
exercises.description:
Climb X easy boulders at low intensity, prioritizing rhythm and smooth movement throughout. 1 minute per boulder, rest the remainder of the time.
Intent: develop aerobic capacity and forearm capillarisation through high-volume, very low-intensity bouldering.

exercises.name: Progressive Edge pickup
exercises.description: For end of warmup, progress loads over sets, repeat highest load for last set. Build to 80% of the last tested max; record effort on that hold.

exercises.name: Strength intervals
exercises.description:
Repeat hard but submaximal boulders in structured sets with near-full recovery. Operate near your upper strength threshold across all sets.
Intent: increase strength endurance and repeatable force production.

exercises.name: Boulder triples
exercises.description:
Climb a hard boulder 3 times per set with short rest between reps, completing multiple sets.
Intent: develop anaerobic capacity through repeated high intensity efforts that builds fatigue across reps and the course of the session.

exercises.name: Limit board
exercises.description: Max efforts, long rests.

exercises.name: Benchmarks or classics
exercises.description: Fewer attempts, not less time: e.g. ~6 problems × ~3 tries, 6 min rest.

exercises.name: Board volume
exercises.description: Problems just above flash level, varied styles.

exercises.name: Wide pull-up
exercises.description: Intent: develop capacity and tissue tolerance

exercises.name: Lateral raise
exercises.description: Pause at the top.

exercises.name: Bent-over fly
exercises.description: Rear delt + scapular retraction; pause at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.description: Shoulders on a secure bench, brief top pause.

exercises.name: Hammer rotation
exercises.description: Pronation/supination, controlled 2–3 s.

exercises.name: Sciatic sliders
exercises.description: No sustained stretch, no provoked tingling. Always first.

exercises.name: Active 90/90
exercises.description: Controlled; hand support if needed.

exercises.name: Loaded Cossack
exercises.description: ~3 s lowering, controlled depth.

exercises.name: Frog PAILs/RAILs
exercises.description: Each set: 30 s settle → 10 s push → 10 s pull → 20 s relax.

exercises.name: Wall straddle
exercises.description: Stop at tingling.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.description: Dumbbell or band. Pelvis stacked.

exercises.name: Fire hydrant
exercises.description: 2 s pause. Stop before pelvic rotation substitutes.

exercises.name: Side-split iso
exercises.description: Stable width.

exercises.name: Boulder Mileage
exercises.description:
Complete 20 boulders in one hour at a challenging but manageable intensity, aiming to flash or complete each within two attempts.
Intent: Build capacity and tolerance for sustained, high-volume bouldering at a controlled mid-intensity.

exercises.name: Deficit sumo goblet squat
exercises.description: 3 s down, 2 s pause at depth.

exercises.name: Middle split PAILs/RAILs
exercises.description: Each set: 30 s settle → 10 s push → 10 s pull → 20 s relax. Hands on a support.

exercises.name: Frog lift-offs
exercises.description: Hold each lift-off for 5 s.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge slide
exercises.description: 4 s out.

exercises.name: Front split
exercises.description: Front knee soft, foot pointed.

modules.name: Wrist block

modules.name: FA · main end range
